scope: Authorised Electoral Act 2002 versions effective on the 2010, 2014, 2018 and 2022 Victorian State election dates

materialRuleComparison.result: no material difference across the four historical cycles
materialRuleComparison.note: Pagination, typography and unrelated amendments differ between authorised Act versions; the encoded Council ballot and count provisions do not.

limitations: The configuration specifies the historical legal count method; it does not create missing pre-election model inputs.
Council election results remain scoring-only outcomes and cannot enter a pre-election information set.
Completion of this component does not authorise a historical replay, probability calibration or production release.
